main_logic: Flood is measured as water depth above station grade (ft) at the facility point.
FEMA Hazus-MH 2.1 Table 7.9 whole-substation depth-damage ratios used as published (0 to 15% over 0 to 10 ft), the same table already carried by the flood_wind cell.
The damage ratio is a share of the replacement value of the same fenced station, $27,353,236.37 (MISO MTEP24 published table amounts, no extra uplift), applied once.

steps.name: What it covers
steps.meaning: The parts that have a curve, their share of the value, and what has none yet
paragraphs: Flood on substations: FEMA Hazus-MH 2.1 Table 7.9 whole-substation depth-damage ratios used as published (0 to 15% over 0 to 10 ft), the same table already carried by the flood_wind cell. It names 1 part: Whole station (fenced assembly). Outside its scope: external access road and project support allowances ($3.06M, outside the fenced value; unmodeled, not zero), land and anything outside the fence and movable contents, outage and business interruption. Kinds of damage it does not include: salinity and contamination, waves, velocity and scour and debris.
For this hazard the substation is split into 1 part: Whole station (fenced assembly).

The damage ratio is a share of replacement value of the same fenced station, $27,353,236.37 (MISO MTEP24 published table amounts, no extra uplift), applied once. The files state no plant-level dollar figure for this asset.

steps.name: How damage is worked out
steps.meaning: How the hazard is measured, the shape of the curve, and the site adjustments
steps.fact: water depth above station grade → a line through points
paragraphs: Damage is read against water depth above station grade (ft) at the facility point (ft). The curve is a line through fixed points (piecewise linear). The input, in the catalogue's words: water depth above station grade (ft) at the facility point, 0 to 10 ft; sub-peril (pluvial, riverine or coastal) must be stated; deeper or missing depth is withheld.
The seven-step audit is written in the dossier with 7 rows. A site-condition adapter has not been written for this cell.
